SIMILAR.hint: Sells the same sort of thing

infoDialog.title: How these shops were found
infoDialog.body: We match the shop names on your card statement against shops running deals. An exact or strong match is the shop you actually used. A similar match only shares a word describing the trade — a coffee place matching another coffee place — so it is somewhere like yours, not the same shop.

qa.title: Questions & answers
qa.a1: Lessley links your connected cards to loyalty clubs and flags purchases where you're missing out on cashback, points or discounts — so you don't have to track it yourself.
qa.q2: Is it safe to connect my bank?
qa.a2: Yes. Bank access is read-only and can be revoked at any time from the Open banking screen.
qa.a3: Match level controls how confident Lessley must be before it suggests a club match — a stricter level means fewer but more accurate matches.
qa.a4: Muting a category or tag hides its purchases from matches and notifications, without deleting any data.
qa.q5: Will signing out delete my data?
qa.a5: No. Signing out only ends your session — your clubs, preferences and connected cards stay exactly as they are.
qa.q6: Can I change the app language?
qa.a6: Yes, open Settings → Language and pick your preferred language at any time.
